defs.def: an occasion when people pack a meal and take it to eat outdoors, especially in the countryside 野餐

ex.s: We have picnics, read books under big trees, and listen to the birds singing in the branches.
ex.t: 我们野餐、在大树下读书，听鸟儿在枝头歌唱。

ex.s: Some of the best family holidays involve things like picnics, camping, hikes, and forest walks.
ex.t: 一些最好的家庭假期包括野餐、露营、远足和森林漫步等活动。

ex.s: We went on nature walks, had picnics on beautiful beaches and drank hot chocolate underthestars.
ex.t: 我们去大自然散步，在美丽的海滩上野餐，在星空下喝热巧克力。
晚上7:00　颁奖典礼与野餐。

ex.s: B: Well, it’s going to be sunny in the morning and not very windy, so I’m having a picnic with my friends.
ex.t: B:嗯,明天早上会很晴朗,但风力不强,所以我要和我的朋友们一起野餐。

defs.def: the meal, usually consisting of sandwiches, salad and fruit, etc. that you take with you when you go on a picnic 野餐食物
